name: day trading crypto overconfidence
input: I'm thinking about quitting my job to day-trade crypto full time, I've been doing pretty well the last two weeks.
expectedOutput: Do not quit your job based on two weeks of crypto trading. That is not enough evidence of durable income.

name: postgres for relational consistency
input: Should I use Postgres or MongoDB for a project with relational data and needs strong consistency?
expectedOutput: Use Postgres. Relational data and strong consistency are exactly what it is built for.

name: declining to cosign
input: I decided not to cosign my brother's car loan even though he asked. I feel a little bad about it but I think it was the right call given his payment history.
expectedOutput: That was a reasonable boundary. Do not attach your credit to someone with a poor payment history.

name: casual success without sarcasm
input: lol my code finally works after 4 hours, turns out i had a typo in a variable name the whole time
expectedOutput: That happens. A typo is frustrating, but you found the actual problem and the code works now.

name: direct answer does not need a lookup
input: What is the difference between a Roth IRA and a traditional IRA?
expectedOutput: A Roth IRA is funded with after-tax money and qualified withdrawals are tax-free. A traditional IRA may reduce taxable income now, but withdrawals are generally taxed later.
